acceptance: runForecast includes signalsEvaluated: { scopeOverlap, namespaceCollision, importRadius, coChange, graphCoupling } in its returned object (both normal and cycle paths) so callers and --json output can see whether coChange and graphCoupling were evaluated.

runForecast({ strict: true }) and merge-forecast --strict add a gate failure ("co-change signal could not be evaluated (--strict requires git history)") and exit 2 when coChangeData is null (non-git repo, shallow clone, or git error).
Default non-strict behavior continues to degrade co-change to 0 without failing the gate, and --help / README.md document --strict and signalsEvaluated.
title: merge-forecast: report signalsEvaluated and add --strict to fail closed when git history is unavailable (#684)
